evaluations.question: What are the gotchas with CharacterBody3D and Jolt Physics in Godot 4.6?
evaluations.label: pass

real_world_sources.solution_summary: Bug: Using CharacterBody3D move_and_collide() from _process() (not _physics_process()) with Jolt physics sometimes fails to generate collision responses. Fixed in 4.7. Workaround: use _physics_process() or adjust collision logic.
Bug: CharacterBody3D apply_floor_snap() onto an AnimatableBody3D can cause catapulting when velocity.y has a small positive value. Workaround: explicitly set velocity.y = 0 when on floor.
Bug: Reparenting a CharacterBody3D with KeepGlobalTransform=true falsely triggers distant Area3D nodes at world origin. Confirmed, assigned, open. Only occurs with Jolt physics, not Godot Physics.

evaluations.question: How do I fix GLB model import scale issues from Meshy in Godot?
evaluations.label: pass

real_world_sources.solution_summary: Bug: Mesh origin point shifts away from world origin when scaling imported GLB/OBJ geometry (not Godot-native QuadMesh). Affects GLB and OBJ. Open, no fix. Disabling 'Generate LODs' is part of reproduction.

Official 3D model export conventions. Godot uses right-handed Y-up coordinates, -Z camera forward, +Z asset front. Recommends triangulation before export, Apply Transforms in Blender, 1 unit = 1 meter. Post-import scaling can cause floating-point precision issues.
Bug: GLTF nodes using 'matrix' instead of TRS (translation/rotation/scale) had incorrect bone rest transforms (Identity). Fixed in 4.4. Relevant for GLB import issues with scaling/rotation.
